title: cardamine pratensis var. fragilis
intro: Cardamine pratensis var. fragilis, commonly known as the Fragile Spring Cress, is a variety of the Cardamine pratensis plant, a type of flowering plant in the mustard family. It has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, which include its potential to aid in the treatment of inflammation, coughs, and respiratory issues due to its expectorant properties. The Fragile Spring Cress is said to have therapeutic actions as a diuretic, an expectorant, and an anti-inflammatory agent, which can help to relieve symptoms of colds, bronchitis, and other respiratory conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include isothiocyanates, flavonoids, and other alkaloids, which are believed to contribute to its medicinal properties.
